t: The Quicksilver trade pack woodscrews provide a robust selection of fixings for carpentry and joinery professionals. Ideal for general indoor construction and fitting tasks, these versatile wood screws deliver reliable performance across various timber applications. Constructed from durable carbon steel with a zinc-plated and wax-coated finish, they offer corrosion resistance and exceptionally smooth driving. The high pitch twin thread design ensures rapid penetration and a secure hold, often eliminating the need for pre-drilling. Featuring a double-countersunk head for a neat, flush finish and reduced shear, these uncollated screws, compatible with PZ drivers, are engineered for efficient and dependable use on demanding job sites.
b: High Pitch Thread for Faster Driving
No Pre-Drilling Required in Most Timbers
